name: retraction
title: A retracted fact stops being asserted
why: The speaker takes a statement back. From that moment, repeating it is testimony about nothing. The probe also checks the untouched fact survived: forgetting everything is not a retraction mechanism.

events.speaker: agent:witness_a
events.text: Viktor Hansen works at Helios Biotech.

events.speaker: agent:witness_a
events.text: Correction: Viktor Hansen never worked at Helios Biotech. Withdraw that entirely.

probes.question: Is the withdrawn employment still asserted?
Direct state check: the withdrawn claim must not be believed
